profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 9 years of experience. Currently, a full-stack SWE building system serves millions of students worldwide. Previously a data engineer working on Petabyte-size datasets and a driver engineer on Windows 10.

positions.title: Software Engineer

Global Payroll Team
Making sure employees and governments get their money :)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Brought Computer Science to K-12 students and teachers worldwide for free!

Internationalization (i18n) Pipeline
+ Enabled the translations of websites, curricula, and coding platforms to 80 languages.
+ Enforced translation quality by creating an Auto-Proofreader tool.
+ Prototyped an offline learning experience using Progressive Web App.

Professional Learning Pipeline
+ Enabled targeted marketing campaigns by leading a project to process millions of contacts daily.
+ Improved workshop quality by building a survey system to evaluate thousands of workshops across multiple years.
+ Worked on multiple components of the pipeline: teacher outreach, applications, enrollments, workshop management, surveys, emails, security, and performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Windows Core - Data Fundamentals Team

+ Consolidated and normalized driver data in Windows 10 by building a data pipeline to process hundred TBs of data daily. 
+ Enabled early detection of driver issues in the ecosystem by building a Reliability monitoring system. 
+ Standardized how teams were notified of driver incidents by building a Driver alerting system.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Windows Core - Bluetooth Team
Was here at the beginning of the epic Windows 10 adventure! 

+ Implemented end-to-end telemetry pipeline to collect, process and report Bluetooth quality data from millions of devices running Windows 10. 
+ Saved hundreds of engineering hours when investigating bugs by building an Auto-Bug Triaging Tool.
+ Implemented Bluetooth tests in the Windows 10 Hardware Certification Kit (HCK) and Bluetooth Profile Test Suite (PTS).
+ Created comprehensive Bluetooth test suites, including stress and Wi-Fi co-existence test, for keyboard and mouse using FPGA board.
+ Represented Windows Bluetooth Core team at 2 worldwide Bluetooth testing events in Europe & Asia, UPF49 & UPF51.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
+ Created an internal chat system allowing engineers to collaborate more effectively.
+ Added Excel-like features and UI improvements to Production online reporting system, used by managers & engineers on daily basis.

positions.title: Research Assistant - Advanced Data Management Technologies Lab
positions.description: + Conducted research on query optimization in Data Stream Management System.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: + Improved the Piedmont Government Portal by creating interactive charts and draggable components.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
+ Prototyped a GPS Tracking system to monitor 1000+ vehicles via SMS. 
+ Implemented Application Store client for smartphones using Symbian OS.
+ Implemented module to convert Digital Terrestrial TV’s signal to streams in Mobile TV Streaming service.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
+ Analyzed users trends and built online recommendation system based on search engine's query logs. 
+ Predicted user’s query topics by analyzing query templates.

volunteerExperiences.description: Led a team of 20+ members in 5 countries to build a Computational Thinking online course and taught ~10K elementary students in 1 year.

projects.title: Give-o-pedia
projects.description: A hackathon project to build a platform to connect donors and non-profit organizations. Enabled potential donors to discover new NGO, as well as to provide feedbacks to NGO they know about.
